scenarios.name: Public shop filters include the 18.00 boundary and exclude 17.99
Student signs in, claims a voucher and sees it in the private wallet
Duplicate claim returns 409 and the same claim survives logout and login
Merchant lists owned shops including offline shops and can restore visibility
Other merchants cannot open another shop's management form
A merchant cannot redeem another shop's voucher
Owning merchant redeems once and receives 409 for a duplicate
Student refresh displays redeemed status and redemption time
Injected 503 preserves the active session and allows recovery
Injected 401 clears the session and all displayed private vouchers
A delayed private merchant response cannot repopulate the page after logout
OpenAPI declares bearer authentication for all eight protected operations
